notes: Cases use frozen aggregate expected goals from Predictions plus regulation-time final scores recovered from Reviews, Match Statistics, or authoritative result sources.
They test V1 versus V2.1 scoreline generation only; they do not reconstruct underlying model evidence weights.
A neutral 1X2 probability wrapper is used when constructing ModelOutput because scoreline replay consumes expected goals, not 1X2 probabilities.
Recovery never back-fills missing pre-match xG from post-match statistics.
AET matches use the regulation-time score only when the historical record makes that score unambiguous.
